demos.name: ListView
demos.description: Unlike the default grid view, list view requires you to explicitly define how columns and cells are displayed by passing the listViewColumn prop with a renderCe

demos.name: ListViewMediaQuery
demos.section: Responsive list view with media query
demos.description: Use the useMediaQuery() hook from @mui/material to enable the list view feature at a specified breakpoint.
